Mango.why: Mangoes thrive in the Kimberley's hot, dry climate with wet summers.
Mango.irrigation_system: Micro-sprinkler or drip irrigation to conserve water.
Mango.grazing: Limited grazing possible but generally avoided to protect trees.
Mango.suitability: Ideal for horticulture; significant export potential.

Passionfruit.why: Passionfruit grows well in warm climates with good rainfall or irrigation.
Passionfruit.irrigation_system: Drip irrigation to maintain consistent soil moisture.
Passionfruit.grazing: Not suitable for grazing due to vine structure.
Passionfruit.suitability: Horticultural crop with high market demand.

Sugar Cane.why: Sugar cane benefits from the Kimberley's tropical climate and ample water supply.
Sugar Cane.irrigation_system: Furrow or drip irrigation to meet high water needs.
Sugar Cane.suitability: Agricultural crop; not suitable for viticulture or horticulture.

Banana.why: Bananas are well-suited to the region's warm, humid conditions.
Banana.irrigation_system: Overhead or drip irrigation to ensure adequate moisture.
Banana.grazing: Not suitable due to risk of plant damage.

Papaya.why: Papayas grow rapidly in warm climates and are suited to the Kimberley region.
Papaya.suitability: Horticultural crop with high nutritional value.

Pineapple.why: Pineapples thrive in warm temperatures and well-drained soils.
Pineapple.irrigation_system: Drip irrigation to conserve water and prevent diseases.
Pineapple.grazing: Not suitable due to spiky foliage.
Pineapple.suitability: Horticultural crop with good market demand.
